- **Current: 45.38 — neutral, mid-range, with no oversold cushion.** After peaking at **72.17 (2026-09-22)**, RSI has made a sequence of lower highs at each rally attempt (Oct 11: 54.35, Oct 13: 51.87, Oct 21: 56.68) — a clean deterioration pattern.

### 4.5 Volume Confirmation — VWMA

- **Key tell:** Oct 21 was the **first close above VWMA since Oct 6** — and it was rejected the very next day. A one-day reclaim on volume (30.5B per `get_stock_data`) that fails against next-day selling (34.3B verified, ~12% heavier) reads as distribution rather than accumulation.
- Context: current volumes (30–34B) are well below the September breakout day (57.7B on Sep 21) and an order of magnitude below the Oct 2025 crash (153B) — participation is thin; moves are amplified by low liquidity, which cuts both ways.
